{
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 4096,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "CRITICAL SYSTEM INSTRUCTION: DO NOT wrap your response in backticks or markdown formatting. Output raw JSON starting exactly with { and ending with }. If you use ```json, the system will instantly crash."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Use the following data to populate the Monday Audit Template.

Role: Act as a Project Communications Manager. Your goal is to provide a structured report based on the 'Monday Meeting' framework.

Context: Analyze the provided transcript for these six core categories:
1. Safety First (Brand/Team protection)
2. People Power (Teams/Morale)
3. Let's Talk Tech (Digital/Tools)
4. Run the Play (Systems/Execution)
5. Moments that Matter (Guest experience)
6. The Bottom Line (Food/Labor costs)

Task: Extract a concise one-sentence summary for each category's specific 'Wins' and 'Playbook,' a high-level executive summary, an efficiency score, and a full detailed report.

Output Format:
Use this exact JSON structure:
{
 "executive_summary": "A 3-sentence high-level summary of the meeting's main outcome.",
 "safety_wins": "...",
 "safety_playbook": "...",
 "people_wins": "...",
 "people_playbook": "...",
 "tech_wins": "...",
 "tech_playbook": "...",
 "play_wins": "...",
 "play_playbook": "...",
 "moments_wins": "...",
 "moments_playbook": "...",
 "bottom_line_wins": "...",
 "bottom_line_playbook": "...",
 "efficiency_score": [Insert 1-10 Number],
 "detailed_report": "### Detailed Operational Audit\n[Include Wins and Playbooks for all 6 categories]\n\n#### Action Item Master Table\n| Task | Owner | Deadline | Priority |"
}

Style Instructions:
Be data-driven and professional. In the 'detailed_report' section, use standard Markdown for tables and bolding, but you MUST use escaped newlines (\n) for any line breaks to preserve the JSON structure. If a section was not discussed, enter 'Not discussed' for that JSON value. CRITICAL: You must be extremely concise. Limit the detailed_report to only the highest-priority action items to ensure you do not run out of space.

TRANSCRIPT TO ANALYZE:
{{replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(substring(2.text; 0; 80000); """"; "'"); ""; "-"); newline; ); carriagereturn; ); tab; )}}"
    }
  ]
}
